name: Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM
summary: Turn off Hisense viewing tracking, VIDAA preloads and store demos on the Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM. TidyTV is a free phone app with a backup and a one-tap undo.
intro: This Hisense ships with an ACR viewing tracker (automatic content recognition, which watches what is on screen), a VIDAA app preload and Hisense push-message services. It also has retail, store and hotel demo modes, over-the-air update services, Google home-screen movie and music rows, and voice assistant apps.

The list was applied on one set in seven groups, with a restart after each. The TV booted normally, and HDMI-CEC, the inputs and Live TV kept working. TidyTV turns these items off from your phone over Wi-Fi. It saves a backup first, switches each app off without deleting it, and stops if something looks wrong.
keep: MediaTek packages, including the Live TV and HDMI app.
HDMI-CEC and the inputs, which keep working with this list.
notes: While Google Assistant and voice search are off, the remote's microphone button stops working.
Some Hisense system apps were left on, because a test that turned off three of them sent one TV into Android Recovery. If that screen appears, choose 'Try again', not 'Factory data reset'.
Firmware updates are turned off with the update apps. Turn them back on with their switches to receive an update.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM?
faq.a: Not while Google Assistant and voice search are off. The list turns them off, and the remote's microphone button stops working until you turn them back on.

faq.q: Will I still get firmware updates?
faq.a: Not while the update apps are off. Turn them back on with their switches to receive an update.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off the viewing tracker, the VIDAA app preload, the Hisense push messages and the Google home-screen movie and music rows. Restore everything turns them back on in one tap.
